source_text.body:
Catch mistyped receipt amounts in expense records
Claude Cowork found several expenses with mistyped receipt amounts that added up to $922.
·
Sep 1, 2025
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
The poster downloaded bank statements and copies of expense claims, then asked Claude to reconcile them and flag issues. Claude compared the records, surfaced several mistyped receipt amounts, and found one March claim where the wrong currency had been entered; in comments, the poster said it also caught one duplicate-submitted claim. The person reviewed the findings and used them to reclaim the missing reimbursements.
How it went
It identified reimbursement errors totaling $922, including a single $768 miss caused by the wrong currency. The post does not describe any broader automation beyond finding the discrepancies.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that this was a manual audit of downloaded statements and claims, and the poster said the same work could have been done in Claude Code but they preferred Cowork’s GUI.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Go through my expense records in [folder or spreadsheet] and compare each logged amount with the amount on its matching receipt in [receipts folder]. List every mismatch with the date, vendor, logged amount, receipt amount and the difference, and give the total. Don't change any files; just give me the report.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeCowork/comments/1w5h0xk/cowork_helped_me_find_922_today
